value.rationale: The question is physically motivated by a fixed catalyst/reaction resource split between two finite-kinetics walls under distributed Poisson resetting. Its side selection is exactly budget-independent, reducing an optimization across all resource levels to one observable source-law odd moment. The two-site law exhibits a genuine finite-frequency reversal of optimal reaction-site emphasis, with an exact universal threshold independent of budget. This supplies a structural design criterion rather than a trivial parameter substitution; no noisy experimental stability or joint control of resets is asserted.
